meals.name: Kefir & Raspberry Smoothie + Fried Eggs on Sourdough with Avocado-Style Olive Spread
meals.image_prompt: overhead photo of two fried eggs on toasted sourdough bread with a side of olive spread, a glass of pink kefir raspberry smoothie, fresh raspberries scattered, natural morning light on a wooden table
day_of_steps: 1. Pour 250 ml plain kefir into a blender with 80 g raspberries (Diego) / 60 g raspberries (Diana) and half a banana (Diego) / one-third banana (Diana). Blend 30 seconds. Pour into glasses.
2. Toast 40 g sourdough (Diego) / 30 g sourdough (Diana) in the toaster.
3. Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat with a few drops of olive oil. Crack 2 eggs per person into the pan. Fry sunny-side up 3–4 minutes until whites are set.
4. Spread 1 tbsp (15 g) hummus or olive tapenade (from pantry) on each toast slice as avocado-style spread. Slide eggs on top.
5. Serve smoothie alongside. Drink 500 ml water.

meals.name: Mediterranean Beef & Lentil Bowl with Roasted Bell Peppers & Quinoa
meals.image_prompt: overhead photo of a wholesome bowl with herbed ground beef, red lentils, roasted red and yellow bell peppers, fluffy quinoa, drizzle of olive oil, cherry tomatoes, on a rustic ceramic plate, natural light
prep_steps: Sunday: Cook 300 g dry quinoa in 600 ml water. Portion into containers.
Sunday: Drain and rinse 2 cans lentils (800 g). Season with cumin, oregano, olive oil. Store.
Sunday: Roast sliced bell peppers with olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic. Store in fridge.
Sunday: Brown 700 g ground beef with garlic, cumin, paprika, tomato passata. Cool and store.
day_of_steps: 1. Reheat 150 g cooked ground beef (Diego) / 110 g (Diana) in a pan over medium heat 3–4 min.
2. Reheat 100 g cooked quinoa (Diego) / 75 g (Diana) and 80 g lentils (Diego) / 60 g (Diana) alongside in a second pan or microwave.
3. Reheat 100 g roasted bell peppers (Diego) / 80 g (Diana).
4. Add 5 cherry tomatoes halved (both) to each bowl.
5. Assemble: quinoa base, lentils, beef, peppers, tomatoes. Drizzle 2 tsp olive oil (Diego) / 1.5 tsp (Diana). Splash balsamic vinegar. Serve with 500 ml water.
6. Eat vegetables and lentils first (Glucose Goddess). Follow with 1 orange (Diego) / small apple (Diana) as fruit.

meals.image_prompt: a plated fillet of soy-ginger baked salmon with vibrant stir-fried zucchini and wilted spinach, a slice of toasted sourdough on the side, sesame glaze visible, warm restaurant lighting
day_of_steps: 1. Preheat oven to 200 °C. Line a baking tray with parchment.
2. Mix 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp sesame oil, ½ tsp ground ginger, 1 tsp garlic powder in a bowl.
3. Place salmon fillets on tray — 160 g raw for Diego, 120 g raw for Diana. Spoon marinade over each. Bake 14–16 min until cooked through.
4. Meanwhile heat 1 tsp olive oil in a pan. Add 1 crushed garlic clove, sliced zucchini — 120 g (Diego) / 100 g (Diana). Stir-fry 3 min.
5. Add 60 g spinach per person, splash soy sauce. Toss 1–2 min until wilted.
6. Toast sourdough — 40 g (Diego) / 30 g (Diana).
7. Plate: veg first, salmon alongside, toast on side. Drizzle ½ tsp sesame oil. Serve with 500 ml water.
8. Eat vegetables first (Glucose Goddess order).
